verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs focus on single-page primitives (act/observe/extract) and single-session agent workflows; there is no evidence of built-in bulk/batch operation support (e.g., running the same action across many items, URLs, or records in parallel) or a bulk API surface. missing for 10: any documentation of parallel/batch execution across multiple items, batch job scheduling, or a bulk-processing API.
